mapper.sql: m.member_id id, m.tenant_id tenantId, m.account_id accountId, t.owner_ref_id clientId, m.status, t.owner_status ownerStatus, t.security_status securityStatus

FROM t_tenant_member m JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.tenant_type='CLIENT' JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=m.account_id AND a.realm='CUSTOMER' AND a.account_type='HUMAN'
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE m.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.owner_status<>'PENDING' AND m.status<>'REVOKED' ORDER BY t.tenant_id LIMIT 50
